races.title: CopyBet Back Again At Hereford Fillies' Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: PRINCESS OF HABO 's Flat form on the continent is the best on offer and she can make a winning start over hurdles having joined the increasingly powerful Jamie Snowden team. Koala Rose was also above average on the level and is much respected now representing Dan Skelton, whilst C&D winner Echo Valley took well to this discipline on her debut in this sphere. PRINCESS OF HABO (IRE) KOALA ROSE (IRE) ECHO VALLEY
races.bettingForecast: Koala Rose (4/7), Echo Valley (6/4), Princess Of Habo (13/8), Antiquarian (16/1)

races.title: Paul Fergusons Jumpers To Follow EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Dual-bumper winner GOVERNORS ROCK was found out in better company at Cheltenham last time, but this looks a good opportunity for him to resume winning ways. Moscow Star was much improved from hurdling debut when runner-up at Sedgefield last month and can give the selection most to think about, ahead of Jaunty Trooper , who has shown some promise in bumpers and has a fine jumping pedigree. GOVERNORS ROCK (IRE) MOSCOW STAR (FR) JAUNTY TROOPER

races.title: CopyBet For Nations League Profit Boosts Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: MR JUKEBOX went close to defying a penalty at Perth when last seen and Warren Greatrex's charge remains unexposed as a handicapper, so gets the verdict over Lydeard Girl who signed off last season with a career-best second at Wincanton. Recent Market Rasen winner Lightning Flash is also considered after a 7 lb rise. MR JUKEBOX (IRE) LYDEARD GIRL LIGHTNING FLASH (IRE)

races.title: CopyBet BOG Now For Cheltenham Tomorrow Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ONEINTHEWELL 's latest form is working out well, and he may just get away with the return to a right-handed track. Alan Bresil could be the main danger if blinkers continue to have a positive effect. Stable debutant Elated shades Cinnodin (finished third on Tuesday) in the best-of-the-rest vote. ONEINTHEWELL (IRE) ALAN BRESIL ELATED
races.bettingForecast: Elated (1/1), Alan Bresil (2/1), Cinnodin (5/2), Oneinthewell (9/2), Lord Cauvelliere (20/1), Wishful Wings (20/1)

races.title: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: TARITINO has presumably been freshened up following a busy/productive season on the Flat and could be weighted to add to his hurdles tally.
